description: This file defines CMake functions and macros for configuring, generating, and installing header-only libraries and packages within a CMake-based project. It handles locating templates, setting up dependencies, creating package configuration files, and installing necessary files for header-only libraries.

methods.name: HeaderOnlyInstallCMakeConfig
methods.description: Configures and installs a header-only library target, generating and installing the corresponding CMake config files, handling dependencies, and creating target aliases.

methods.name: HeaderOnlyInstallPackageConfig
methods.description: Creates and installs a pkg-config file for a header-only package, including setting include directories, compile options, defines, and library paths.
